verdict.rationale: Meltano's EL layer extracts raw data via Singer taps and loaders into destinations, and transformations to typed, deduplicated tables are handled via dbt integration (meltano-docs-6, meltano-docs-11), not natively as part of loading itself. Incremental state tracking (meltano-docs-20) helps avoid re-extracting full data, but deduplication and typing into query-ready tables depend on the analytics engineer writing dbt models, and there's no direct evidence describing automatic schema typing or dedup at load time. missing for 10: evidence of automatic typed/deduplicated destination tables without requiring separate dbt modeling, evidence of schema evolution handling, independent confirmation of load-time data quality guarantees.
